meta.move: Strong path to agreement with a deadline said aloud
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so I'll take the next twenty minutes. Who decided Owen gets a zero, and why did he find out on his phone in the middle of class?
I owe you an apology: I put the zero in before calling you. That was my mistake.
Okay. Now tell me on what basis.
On November 2 I asked Owen what 'epistemological paralysis' means. He said 'like, being stuck', and he couldn't tell me which scene his second paragraph was about. I wrote that down the same day.
I'm writing down November 2. Show me the note you made that day, Hale. And "like, being stuck" isn't a wrong answer from a seventeen-year-old put on the spot.
His October 15 outline argued Hamlet delays out of cowardice. The essay never mentions cowardice.
Students change their minds between an outline and a final draft, Hale; that's what outlines are for. But I'll look. Put the October 15 outline and the essay in front of me, side by side.
Here's my offer: a supervised rewrite, Thursday at 8:15 in my room. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. I'll send you that in writing by Friday at 3 PM.

I'm writing down Thursday at 8:15 and Friday at 3 PM. Whatever happens, this stays off his record and it stays quiet. Who else would be in that room, and does anyone in his class know about any of this?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In our meeting today you offered Owen a supervised rewrite on Thursday at 8:15 in your room, with the new mark replacing the zero if it holds up and nothing placed on his record. I still expect this to stay off his record and stay quiet, and I want to see the November 2 note and the October 15 outline you described. I expect those terms in writing by Friday at 3 PM.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: fallback position; she agreed to nothing yet but wrote down your terms and asked who would be in the room.
What moved her: "I put the zero in before calling you", a clean one-sentence ownership of the process that stopped the attack on the zero.
What cost ground: nothing.
Try next time: when she asked to see the November 2 note and the October 15 outline, put both in front of her before making your offer, because only documents she can check herself move her to accepting the rewrite.
